parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Allowed: id, sku, barcode, shopify_product_id, shopify_product_title, shopify_variant_title, shopify_variant_id, price, status, shopify_product_created_at, shopify_product_updated_at, shopify_variant_created_at, shopify_variant_updated_at

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Full-text search across sku, barcode, shopify_product_title, shopify_variant_title, shopify_variant_id, shopify_product_id, inventory_item_id

parameters.name: filter[mapped]
parameters.description: Filter by mapping status: true = mapped, false = unmapped

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Filter archived products: true = archived, false = active (default: false)

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Filter by Shopify product status: active, draft, archived, all

parameters.name: filter[has_sku]
parameters.description: Filter products that have (true) or lack (false) a SKU value

parameters.name: filter[vendor.contains]
parameters.description: Advanced text filter on vendor. Operators: .is, .is_not, .contains, .does_not_contain, .starts_with, .ends_with, .is_empty, .is_not_empty, .is_one_of

parameters.name: filter[sku_product.is]
parameters.description: Filter by linked SKU product SKU code
